decisions.reason: As a hearty bread loaf close to the bakery’s core range, it fits everyday demand, uses existing craft capabilities, and is unlikely to be withdrawn in a growing market.
The guided historic mill tour matches the firm’s heritage, event, café, and tour offer, though it is somewhat more discretionary and operationally demanding than core baked goods.
A sweet pastry is strongly aligned with the firm’s established confectionery business and can be produced and sold through existing channels with relatively low risk.
